api_keys_payment_limits_check.name: api_keys_payment_limits_check
api_keys_payment_limits_check.value:
case when "api_keys"."kind" = 'payment' then "api_keys"."daily_budget" is not null
    else "api_keys"."allowance" is null and "api_keys"."daily_budget" is null and "api_keys"."max_price" is null and "api_keys"."expires_at" is null end

payments_credits_buyer_check.name: payments_credits_buyer_check
payments_credits_buyer_check.value: "payments"."rail" <> 'credits' or ("payments"."buyer_account_id" is not null and "payments"."key_id" is not null)

target_payments_unbooked_idx.name: target_payments_unbooked_idx
target_payments_unbooked_idx.where: status = 'settled' and not loss_booked and not buyer_charged
